messages:
Maya (Product): Quick proposal — we need to chop the upcoming milestone to hit our launch date without slipping the org. TL;DR: defer tenant-level SSO and advanced RBAC flows to v1, ship core API + console + Optimize beta for MVP. Soft-freeze in 10 days, canary the week after.

Kevin (Eng): Defer SSO ok for GA, but enterprise customers will push. How much work to make a pilot for top accounts?

Maya (Product): Proposal: allow a 'pilot lane' — limited tenant SSO for top 3 deals behind feature flag; not part of GA. Include clear release notes and sales commit.

Jon (Platform): Full tenant SSO end-to-end is ~3w. We can deliver a skeleton (IDP mapping + auth path) in 1.5w but no admin UI.

Sara (Design): RBAC UI can be trimmed to a simple toggle + invite flow. UX polish deferred. Estimate 2 days.

Tony (Sales): Heads-up: Acme and Beacon asked for tenant SSO in contract. They'll accept a pilot but need written timeline. I can get commitments if we offer a 6mo pilot SLA.

Kevin (Eng): Also need to call out rollout risk: model fallback and routing must be solid before canary, otherwise we'll see noisy errors.

Jon (Platform): Runtime fallback exists. Need infra ownership for canary week; we need +1 SRE to pair on emergency rollbacks.

Kai (SRE): I have partial availability; ops-bot shows conflicts for the proposed canary week. I can cover Tue/Thu but need 24h oncall handover.

Maya (Product): OK — action items: 1) Kevin/Jon - tech plan for pilot SSO by EOD (estimates + must-haves). 2) Sara - deliver trimmed RBAC mocks by tomorrow. 3) Tony - secure pilot agreement with top 3 by EOD Friday. 4) Kai - confirm coverage and rollback playbook. We'll freeze scope in 10 days unless major blockers emerge. :thumbsup:

Kevin (Eng): On it. I'll post a short RFC with the dependencies.

Jon (Platform): Agree. I'll list infra tasks and SRE needs.

Tony (Sales): I'll ping legal/sales-engineering loop for Acme.

Sara (Design): Will drop mocks into Figma and share link.

ops-bot: Reminder — release freeze candidate branch created: branch/release/milestone-2026-03. Please attach PRs to that branch.

Maya (Product): Thanks. If anyone has urgent pushback please call it out now; otherwise this is the plan we take into planning sync tomorrow.
